Despite knowing the deadly consequences of getting involved in the nine princes’ competition for the throne, her heart compelled her to engage—because here, she finds both the man she loves and those who love her. 27788.synopsis:
“Shengsheng, Shengsheng…”

People described him as a bright and graceful young man who was as noble as a piece of jade, heh, but they had never seen how he looked cutting open corpses with a scalpel. Oh, how his eyes glowed red.

“Your hands are really pretty,” she exclaimed in genuine admiration and was unable to shift her gaze away. “Can I… touch them?”

She explained, “I’m sorry, I have a slight hand fetish.”

Some time in the future, he stood in the bathroom of their new apartment, holding a scalpel with his bloody hands. His back was to her. There was blood all over the floor, and a broken limb. From the pile of bloody bones, she could tell that they belonged to the stray human she had brought home.
She asked, “What are you doing?”
He answered, “Dissecting a corpse.”
She took a step back, but he pressed her down to the cold floor of the bathroom and ripped off her clothes. The blood on the floor stained her snow-white skin.
He said, “Shengsheng, if I can choose how I die, I hope I die on top of you.”
He said, “Shengsheng, I’m a doctor who can’t cure himself. I’m sick, blood makes me excited and compels me to slaughter, and you make me feel thirsty for blood. You’re the reason why I’m driven to mu*der.”

She took his hand, and said, “Shi Jin, the blood on the floor will dirty my shoes. I want you to carry me out of here.”
She had never loved someone so much that she was willing to descend into hell with him.
He had never loved someone so much that he was willing to set aside his butcher knife for her.

Once again today, she was fiercely fighting a bunch of dumb hyenas.
“A baby kitten?”
She was caught by a tiger beastman who couldn’t even tell the difference between a wildcat and a housecat!
“Kyaong! (Let me go! Let me go!)”
“Why’s this baby kitten so foul-tempered?”
Want to taste these bad-tempered claws?
She tried to scratch the dumb tiger’s face and run away.
But then—
“You hate hyenas too? So do we. Let’s form an alliance.”
Turns out they had a common enemy.
And since she happened to need some protection, she settled down with the tiger clan for the time being.
But these tigers… something’s off.
“Little one, do you like the piggyback ride?”
“Eat. Eat more. Eat until you’re rolling around like a ball.”
“Play with me today.”
They were way too nice for just allies. To the point of saying—
“You! Become our adopted daughter!”
They’re even proposing adoption?
Well, if you insist.
Varya, the great wildcat beastman (age 10).
From today, she will conquer the tiger clan!
associated_names: Baby Cat from the Tiger Family
Baby Wildcat of the Tiger Clan

122508.synopsis:
The world may be in ruins.
But even at the end of all things—
People still need a place to rest.

123020.synopsis:
Lu Qing’an proved his Dao through killing.
After becoming invincible, he grew tired of endless slaughter and wanted a peaceful life.
So he left the Demon Domain, hid his identity as the Demon Emperor, and married the woman he loved as his Dao partner.
A thousand years passed. He had two daughters and a son, living a blissful life.
Even though he had a “Divorce System” that promised him a hundred-millionfold cultivation boost if he ever divorced his wife, he never paid it any mind.
In his words: “I’m already invincible—what the h*ll would I need even more power for?”
Until one day, his youngest daughter let slip that his wife had secretly asked the kids who they would stay with if she and Lu Qing’an separated.
It was at that moment that he realized his wife had already made up her mind to leave him.
So, on the day she ascended the throne and officially became the Empress, she divorced him in public. Watching her cold, determined expression—willing to give up everything to become stronger—he chose to let her go.
He reluctantly accepted the hundred-millionfold cultivation boost, took his two daughters back to the Demon Domain, and poured his efforts into raising them.
In just a few short years, he raised both daughters into Empress-level powerhouses.
Then, on the day his daughters ascended the throne, a disheveled woman appeared before him…
associated_names: 被女帝离婚后，我分走百万倍修为

123532.synopsis:
Agnes Belle Lemanche, the top second-year student in the Department of Magical Engineering, has two secrets she cannot tell anyone.
First.
She was still a virg*n.
But because she unintentionally pretended to be promiscuous in front of her classmates, this must remain an absolute secret.
Second.
Agnes was in love with Kallion, the top student of the second-year Swordsmanship Department.
And if she were to add just one more secret, a third—
Agnes observes Kallion closely every day.
Very closely.
“Agnes, did you hear? Kallion won again today.”
Of course she knew. How could she not?
There was nothing she didn’t know about Kallion! Agnes even knew exactly how many pairs of underwear Kallion kept in his dorm.
However, this was an absolute top secret she could never share with anyone.
Especially not with Kallion himself.
But Agnes had no idea.
No, she couldn’t even imagine.
That, in just a few days, she would become closely entangled with Kallion.
***
Kallion Roy Bishuern, the top student in the Swordsmanship Department at Rondale Academy.
He has two secrets.
First.
He was secretly in love with Agnes of the Department of Magical Engineering.
And another secret is……
“Agnes, you’re so careless.”
Kallion let out a chuckle as he opened his underwear drawer, which hadn’t been properly closed.
She was getting bolder, even coming into his room and peeking at his underwear.
Maybe she’d shoved it in hastily—one pair of navy-blue boxer briefs was sitting crookedly.
Kallion gazed at his underwear that had been touched by her hand and murmured softly,
“Maybe it’s her taste.”
Second.
Kallion knows that she’s stalking him.
‘Ah, it would’ve been even better if she’d pretended not to know and slipped one of her panties in.’
Kallion clicked his tongue briefly in disappointment.
That’s right—he truly welcomed Agnes’s excessive attention.

124300.synopsis:
Knives as proof, words as evidence.
When the prophecy comes true, it’s time to collect payment.**
This is the way of the “Knife-Barterer” in the mystical world.
Tu Shanjiu, the 283rd generation of knife-barterers, possessed a metaphysical talent far surpassing anyone else in her family. Her divinations were frighteningly accurate, and she could communicate with spirits and deities.
Unfortunately, due to a curse the Tu Shan family laid upon themselves a hundred years ago, she wouldn’t live long.
Since childhood, she knew she had a fiancé—a destined partner arranged by her grandfather.
Only by marrying him could she be truly safe.
Before passing away, her grandfather repeatedly reminded her to go down the mountain to the Xie family.
It was time to collect the debt owed by her fiancé’s family.
—
*It was said that the richest family in Nancheng—the Xie family—had a young master named Xie Shiyu, who had been engaged since childhood. His fiancée was said to be some country bumpkin living in a remote mountain village.*
No one could understand why old Master Xie had arranged such a mismatched engagement for his eldest grandson.
But later, when they met her in person—so gentle and quiet, graceful in speech and behavior, with impeccable manners—everyone realized that rumors could not be trusted.
Especially when later on, powerful figures from every industry respectfully addressed her as “Miss Tu Shan,”
Everyone was completely shocked.
Someone once curiously asked them why they were so respectful toward her.
The big shots replied: “Because she’s our creditor!”
—
Tu Shanjiu had always been forgetful since she was a child. She would often forget to collect debts.
After getting married, she simply handed the ledger over to her husband Xie Shiyu and asked him to remind her to collect.
Looking at the thick stack of account books left on his desk, Xie Shiyu fell silent on the spot
In the world of mysticism, there exists a mysterious job called “賒刀人”—literally “Knife-Barterer.” These people lend services (like fortune-telling, protection, or supernatural help) in exchange for a future debt, which they later come to collect once the prophecy comes true.
associated_names: 总裁，夫人她又开始赊刀了
總裁，夫人她又開始賒刀了

125068.synopsis:
A man who had lost everything found himself reincarnated as a dying child…
In a world of sword and magic, torn by war and plagued by man-eating beasts.
And there, the man encounters a girl called Ise.
Through repeated encounters and by overcoming danger, the man grows stronger bit by bit.
But an unavoidable, devastating battle draws near.
In the midst of a life-or-death struggle, what he sees… could it be something called love, or perhaps salvation…?

130700.synopsis:
Holographic Wuxia Game “Riding Through the Jianghu” adopts the most advanced bio-interface technology, with a realism ratio exceeding 99%. Players are warmly welcomed to log in and experience it!
Your satisfaction is our motivation
One-Sentence Summary: The path to dominance in a holographic wuxia online game.
Theme: Balance work and play, strive for progress with diligence.

142988.synopsis:
As a lowly court lady, she fell in love with the Crown Prince.
But, as if rebuking her heart, the Crown Prince threw red hot charcoal at her, and it brushed against her cheek.
Leaving lasting scars on her body and mind.
Six years later, Yeonwoo receives a secret summons from the Empress.
‘Become me, the Empress, and receive imperial favor from His Majesty for one night.’
One night. Just one night.
If she becomes the Empress’s substitute and receives favor by proxy from the Emperor, formerly the Crown Prince, everything can change.

143756.synopsis:
One day, my father brought home a man.
He told me to do whatever I wanted with him—use him as a s*ave, a toy, make him play with me or serve me…
“Remember this. You belong to me.”
“…I understand.”
Elena, who had never set foot outside the Winter Castle due to her father’s strict control, lived a lonely life. Excited by the idea of having a companion, she named the man “Rick” and spent the next three years with him.
It didn’t take long for the two to fall for each other, and Elena truly believed she loved Rick.
She was certain of her feelings.
But then…
“Kill them all.”
Rick, whom she thought had vanished, returned as a tyrant.
And he had forgotten every memory they had shared.
“Ahhh! Rick, please stop…! Just kill me instead…!”
“Are you screaming my name because you enjoy this so much? How utterly disgusting.”
Their roles reversed, their once pure connection turned into a chaotic, twisted relationship. Bound by an unbreakable chain of pain and betrayal, their fates spiraled out of control.
How did we end up like this?

148876.synopsis: A story about an awakened middle-aged man traveling around, leveling up, and meeting women.

189836.synopsis:
[A laid-back drama-loving male lead × a doting, mind-reading female lead. Arranged marriage turns into love. The couple works together. Single female lead.]
I, Pei Cijing, transmigrated into the Second Young Master of an aristocratic marquis household. All I wanted was to idle around and enjoy the drama.
But just as my wedding was approaching, my eldest brother, the heir, actually got tangled up with my fiancée!
Witnessing the scandal firsthand, only to realize the victim was me?
Right when I thought I’d become the laughingstock of the entire capital, the eldest daughter of the Shen family—who was supposed to be my sister-in-law—stepped forward and offered:
“How about… I marry you instead?”
I kept my composure steady as an old dog on the surface, but inside I was ecstatic: This girl has good taste!
Not until after our wedding did I notice something wrong. I was in the middle of my inner monologue: 【My wife is so beautiful today. I want to kiss her…】
She suddenly turned her head, her eyes shimmering: “Granted.”
Wait!
She can hear my inner thoughts?!
Well, well. I may feast on everyone else’s drama, but now she feasts on me—her clueless, silly husband.
associated_names: 你听心声我吃瓜，换嫁夫妻笑哈哈

214924.synopsis:
Kwon Jahyun, an S+ rank ability user, the highest rank and the face of the nation.
Because of his ‘Reverence’ trait, which prevents him from showing weakness in front of others, he has no suitable Guide and is forced to endure without receiving proper Guiding.
Then one day, Jahyun enters into a three-month s*ave contract with Kwon Kyungwoo, the owner of DH and an A-rank Guide who has been living while concealing the fact that he is a Guide.
“Number one is a summons, number two is holding hands, and number three is a hug.”
As Jahyun follows his orders and gets worked to the bone, a new number is added…
“From now on, we’re adding number four. You know what number four is… even if I don’t tell you, right?”
Everything about the contract had been for the sake of using him.
At least, until Kwon Kyungwoo learned what kind of situation Jahyun was in.

225932.synopsis:
Bayan spoke calmly.
“I want to have Your Majesty.”
“…You want to have what?”
Bayan pointed a finger directly at him.
“Your Majesty. Give Your Majesty to me.”
Dhan froze, the smile still fixed on his face.
*
The Siyo clan, possessors of healing powers.
Bayan, who lived despised by her village because she lacked those very powers.
Dhan, who suffers from an endless, agonizing thirst due to a divine punishment.
The story of their fateful love.
